e.title_en: A two-part licence declaration — code MIT and data OGL v3 on separate badges — plus a registry of all 29 datasets with endpoints, licences, access quirks and the dead ends worth avoiding, while coastal erosion is declared modelled but deliberately not priced with a four-part reason
e.title_hk: 把許可分成兩份寫：**代碼 MIT、數據 OGL v3** 各掛一枚徽章，再配一份 29 個數據集的來源登記表（含端點、許可、取數怪癖與**「值得繞開的死路」**）；而「海岸侵蝕」被明確聲明為**已建模但不定價**，並給出四層理由
e.summary: 一份英国住宅险**地理风险图**：**2,736 个邮编区**的交互式分区设色图，为**八种住宅险灾因**定价（**沉降、天气损害、洪水**（河流、海潮与地表水）、**地下水淹水、盗窃、漏失水、火灾、意外损害**），**其中四个天气驱动的灾因用一个 C-vine copula 相连**，**另四个损耗型灾因作为独立支路定价**（**并逐个给出理由**：「盗窃不随风暴路径而来、爆管听命于寒潮、住宅火灾跟从贫困度与住宅类型、意外损害跟从家庭本身」），分成 10 个费率组；**其最值得记的一处是它把「许可」按**部分**分开声明**——**实测其 README 顶部两枚徽章分别写 **`code` → MIT** 与 **`data` → OGL v3**，后者直接指向 **`DATA_SOURCES.md`**（**逐字为「全部 29 个数据集及其端点、**许可**、取数怪癖与**值得绕开的死路**」**）**；**另有三处同一纪律**：**① 一条**已建模但不定价**的灾因声明**（**海岸侵蚀被有意排除在 `premium` 之外**，**四层理由齐全**：**为何排除**（英国标准家财险不承保渐进的侵蚀，且侵蚀是**全损**而非修缮，会**悄悄毁掉评级**）、**为何仍留在 vine 里**（侵蚀由风暴驱动，作为第五维进入 C-vine）、**建的是什么**（2105 年前景内将失去的带状区内的房屋视为在该期限内损失，**并自陈两条假设**，其中「家庭在区内均匀分布」这一条**若有什么影响是低估**）、**为何不出现在好年坏年对照页**（侵蚀是**长期性而非事件性**）**）；**② 一处**把「没有这个功能」本身当成结论**的段落**（**逐字「这就是为什么没有按区的『copula 增益』图层——在校准过的频率上它只是在画蒙特卡洛噪声。**去掉它**就是结论**」**）；**③ 一处**在审计失败之后才改的配色**（**逐字「WCAG 2.1 AA 对比度在四个页面的明暗两模式下**程序化验证**（**从计算样式量测，而不是从纸上的调色板**）。`--ink-muted` 与链接颜色是在这次审计**判掉 23 个元素之后**才调深的」**）
e.summary_hk: 一份英國住宅險**地理風險圖**：**2,736 個郵編區**的交互式分區設色圖，為**八種住宅險災因**定價（**沉降、天氣損害、洪水**（河流、海潮與地表水）、**地下水淹水、盜竊、漏失水、火災、意外損害**），**其中四個天氣驅動的災因用一個 C-vine copula 相連**，**另四個損耗型災因作為獨立支路定價**（**並逐個給出理由**：「盜竊不隨風暴路徑而來、爆管聽命於寒潮、住宅火災跟從貧困度與住宅類型、意外損害跟從家庭本身」），分成 10 個費率組；**其最值得記的一處是它把「許可」按**部分**分開聲明**——**實測其 README 頂部兩枚徽章分別寫 **`code` → MIT** 與 **`data` → OGL v3**，後者直接指向 **`DATA_SOURCES.md`**（**逐字為「全部 29 個數據集及其端點、**許可**、取數怪癖與**值得繞開的死路**」**）**；**另有三處同一紀律**：**① 一條**已建模但不定價**的災因聲明**（**海岸侵蝕被有意排除在 `premium` 之外**，**四層理由齊全**：**為何排除**（英國標準家財險不承保漸進的侵蝕，且侵蝕是**全損**而非修繕，會**悄悄毀掉評級**）、**為何仍留在 vine 裡**（侵蝕由風暴驅動，作為第五維進入 C-vine）、**建的是什麼**（2105 年前景內將失去的帶狀區內的房屋視為在該期限內損失，**並自陳兩條假設**，其中「家庭在區內均勻分布」這一條**若有什麼影響是低估**）、**為何不出現在好年壞年對照頁**（侵蝕是**長期性而非事件性**）**）；**② 一處**把「沒有這個功能」本身當成結論**的段落**（**逐字「這就是為什麼沒有按區的『copula 增益』圖層——在校準過的頻率上它只是在畫蒙特卡洛噪聲。**去掉它就是結論**」**）；**③ 一處**在審計失敗之後才改的配色**（**逐字「WCAG 2.1 AA 對比度在四個頁面的明暗兩模式下**程序化驗證**（**從計算樣式量測，而不是從紙上的調色板**）。`--ink-muted` 與鏈接顏色是在這次審計**判掉 23 個元素之後**才調深的」**）
e.summary_en: A geospatial risk map for UK home insurance: an interactive choropleth of 2,736 postcode districts rating eight home-insurance perils (subsidence, weather damage, flood across rivers, sea and surface water, groundwater flooding, theft, escape of water, fire and accidental damage), with the four weather-driven perils joined by a C-vine copula and the attritional four priced as independent legs with a reason given for each — burglary does not arrive on the storm track, burst pipes answer to cold snaps, dwelling fires follow deprivation and dwelling type, and accidental damage follows the household itself — banded into ten rating groups; **its most notable feature is that it declares licensing part by part**, with two badges at the top of the README reading **code, MIT** and **data, OGL v3**, the latter pointing at a data-sources document described verbatim as covering all 29 datasets with their endpoints, **licences**, access quirks and **the dead ends worth avoiding**; **three further points follow the same discipline**: **first, a peril declared modelled but deliberately not priced** — coastal erosion is kept out of the premium with a four-part reason: why it is excluded (gradual coastal erosion is not covered by standard UK household policies, and erosion is a total loss rather than a repair, so it would quietly wreck the rating), why it is nevertheless kept in the vine (erosion is storm-driven and enters the C-vine as a fifth dimension), what is modelled instead (a property inside the strip projected to be lost by 2105, with two assumptions stated plainly, one of which if anything understates the exposure), and why it is absent from the good-years-versus-bad-years view (erosion is chronic rather than episodic); **second, a passage that treats the absence of a feature as itself the finding** — verbatim, this is why there is no per-district copula-uplift map layer, since at calibrated frequencies it would be drawing Monte Carlo noise, and removing it is the finding; **and third, a palette changed only after an audit failed** — WCAG 2.1 AA contrast was verified programmatically on all four pages in both light and dark modes, measured from computed styles rather than from the palette on paper, and two colour variables were darkened after that audit failed 23 elements
e.body:
**uk-home-insurance-risk-map**（仓库 `SMcode-source/uk-home-insurance-risk-map`）**是一份英国住宅险**地理风险图****：**2,736 个邮编区**的交互式分区设色图，**为八种住宅险灾因定价**，**其中四个天气驱动的灾因用一个 C-vine copula 相连，另四个损耗型灾因作为独立支路定价**，**分成 10 个费率组**，**并有一个对照页把整本的「好年与坏年」分解开**。**实测 ★0、fork 0、许可 **NOASSERTION**（⚠️ **其成因见 ①**——**仓库内有 `LICENSE` 文件，但它同时声明了两套许可，GitHub 无法归入单一 SPDX 标识**）、主语言 Python、仓库体量 **141,750 KB**、创建 2026-07-31、最后推送 2026-09-09、topics 为 `actuarial`／`copula`／`flood-risk`／`geospatial`／`insurance`／`leaflet`／`open-data`／`python`／`risk-modelling`／`uk`**（**均 GitHub API 实测值；创建在解冻窗口之前，推送落在窗口之内**）；**README 实测 62,476 字节**；**仓库实测共 195 个条目（182 个文件、13 个目录）**。本条目属于本轮主题**「按部分声明：许可、能力、交付物与使用者各自适用什么规则」**；**⭐⭐⭐ 它是四条里**把「许可按部分分」写得最完整的一条****。

可核实信息（**均 README 与仓库实测**）：⭐⭐⭐ **① 两枚徽章把「代码许可」与「数据许可」分开写，而数据侧挂着一份 29 个数据集的来源登记表**——**这是本条最值得单独记的一处，也是本会话所见「许可范围」问题最完整的一次正面解决**：**本词条**实测其 README 顶部徽章逐字为** **「Licence: MIT」**（**链接文本为 `code-MIT`，指向 `LICENSE`**）与 **「Data: OGL v3」**（**链接文本为 `data-OGL v3`，指向 `DATA_SOURCES.md`**）**，**另有 `Live site`、`tests`（指向 `.github/workflows/tests.yml`）、`Python 3.13`、`Districts: 2,736`、`Perils: 8 insured + 1` 五枚**；**并逐字说明数据侧登记表的范围**：**「Every hazard input is **open data**, fetched by the scripts here — see **`DATA_SOURCES.md`** for all **29 datasets** with their endpoints, **licences**, access quirks and **the dead ends worth avoiding**.」**⭐⭐⭐ **四处值得记**：**① ⭐⭐⭐ **「代码 MIT」与「数据 OGL v3」是**两枚并列徽章**——**⭐ 本词条指出：这正好解决了本会话第 342 轮在**两条**条目里记录的同一观察（**仓库的许可与其中第三方数据的权利状态是两件不同的事**）；**而这里不是靠免责声明，而是**把两套许可并列挂在门口**，**且数据侧那份文件就是它的依据****；**② ⭐⭐⭐ **它给出**数据集的精确数量**（29）**并逐项列出**端点、许可、取数怪癖**——**⭐ 尤其「取数怪癖」与「**值得绕开的死路**」两栏**：**后者是本会话首次见到的**负面清单**（**不只是「数据在哪」，而是「哪条路走不通」**）**；**③ ⭐⭐ `NOASSERTION` 的成因被本条解释**（**两套许可并列 → GitHub 无法归入单一 SPDX 标识**）**——**⭐ 即**这个「无法归类」本身是**声明方式导致的**，**而不是未声明**；**④ **实测根目录含 `DATA_SOURCES.md`、`LICENSE`、`LIMITATIONS.md`、`HANDOFF.md` 四份文件**——**⭐ 即**限制与交接**各有独立文档****。**② ⭐⭐⭐ **它另有一份「把结论写在顶部的」范围声明，直接否定自己数字的用途**——**逐字为**：**「> ⚠️ These are **eight-peril technical premiums, not home insurance premiums**. A real policy also carries **expenses, commission and profit**. **Expect these figures to be a fraction of what you actually pay.** **This is a methodology demonstration, not a rating product.**」**⭐⭐⭐ **三处值得记**：**① ⭐⭐⭐ **「是八灾因**技术保费**，不是家财险保费」**——**⭐ 即**它把自己的输出**重新命名**为一个更窄的东西**；**② **它列出真实保单还会带的**三项**（**费用、佣金与利润**），**并逐字提示读者实际支付的会是这些数字的**一个零头****；**③ ⭐⭐ **「这是方法学演示，不是定价产品」**——**⭐ 一句话封掉了最常见的误用****。**③ ⭐⭐⭐ **一条**已建模但不定价**的灾因声明，四层理由齐全**——**这是本轮主题最锋利的一处**：**其 README 有一节标题逐字为** **「## Coastal erosion: **modelled, not priced**」**，**正文逐字为**：**「The model carries one further peril — **coastal erosion**, from the EA’s **NCERM National 2024** frontages — and it is **deliberately kept out of `premium`**.」**⭐⭐⭐ **四处理由层层给出**：**① **为何排除**：**「Gradual coastal erosion is **not covered by standard UK household policies**. Putting it in the technical premium would **price a loss no policy pays**, and would **quietly wreck the rating**: erosion is a **total loss of the property rather than a repair**, so where it bites it dwarfs everything else.」****——**⭐ 三条理由各不一样**（**条款不覆盖 / 为一个无人赔付的损失定价 / 全损会压倒其余一切**）**；**② **为何仍留在 vine 里**：**「Erosion is storm-driven: cliffs and beaches retreat in a handful of surge events, not on calm days. **So it belongs in the dependence structure even though it is not priced.**」**——**并给出具体参数**（**作为第五维进入 C-vine，与天气一个 Gumbel 对（θ_we），且在给定天气下与洪水的 tree-2 高斯对是三者中**最强**的（ρ_FE|W = 0.35）**）；**③ **建的是什么，并自陈两条假设**：**「A property inside the strip projected to be lost by the 2105 epoch is lost within that horizon, so the annual hazard is the district’s zone fraction spread over 80 years, at a sum-insured severity. **Two assumptions worth stating plainly:** households are taken as spread **uniformly** across the district（**coastal populations actually cluster towards the shore, so this if anything UNDERSTATES it**），and the **SMP** scenario is used — defences maintained as currently planned. The unmanaged **NFI** case is carried alongside for contrast」****——**⭐ 本词条认为「这条假设若有偏差是**低估**」是很重要的一句：**它指出了自己假设的**方向****；**④ **为何不出现在好年坏年对照页**：**「Erosion is **chronic, not episodic**. Including it would add a near-constant charge to every simulated year and **blur precisely the contrast that page exists to show**. **Capital is likewise allocated against insured losses only.**」****⭐⭐⭐ **并且它给出了**可核对的结果**：**全国层面采纳的方案把 2105 年的土地损失限制在 **250 km²**（**无防护为 435 km²**）**，**并点名具体海滨**（**Blackpool FY1、Eastbourne BN21、Bognor PO21/PO22、Crosby L22 在「Hold the Line」方案下从显著侵蚀变为**恰好为零****），**而在没有海堤的地方，**欧洲侵蚀最快的一段海岸**如实地显现（**Holderness 的 Hornsea HU18 与 Withernsea HU19 居首，其次 Suffolk 海岸的 Southwold IP18**）**。**④ ⭐⭐⭐ **它把「没有这个功能」本身当成结论**——**这是本轮主题在段落层面的又一次出现**：**其 README 有一节标题逐字为** **「## Does the copula actually matter?」**，**正文先给出**测量的方式与规模**（**`scripts/dependence_check.py`，60 个区 × 40 万年**），**再给出**一个分成两半的答案****：**① **对**单栋住宅****：**联合建模使「多灾因年份」的概率变为**94 倍**（**0.11% 对独立性下的 0.0012%**）**——**但该住宅自身的 99% TVaR 几乎不动**（**+2.7%，95% 置信区间 −9.0% 至 +12.8%**，**即与零无法区分**）**，**并逐字解释为何这个区间跨零**：**「**The interval straddling zero is the finding**; its point estimate wanders between runs **precisely because it is noise**, which is why **nothing is priced off it**.」****；**② **对**组合****：**罕见联合事件停止互相抵消**，**巨灾年份的成本比独立性所隐含的**高约 8%****——**⭐ 并说明「这才是资本被设定的依据，也是 vine 在这里的原因」**。**随后逐字给出那个最锋利的结论**：**「This is why there is **no per-district "copula uplift" map layer** — at calibrated frequencies it would be **drawing Monte Carlo noise**. **Removing it IS the finding.**」**⭐⭐⭐ **三处值得记**：**① ⭐⭐⭐ **「去掉它**就是**结论」**——**⭐ 即**一个功能的缺席不是遗漏，而是**被测量出来的正确决定****；**② ⭐⭐ **它把「置信区间跨零」当作**发现**而不是失败**；**③ ⭐⭐ **「点估计在多次运行之间游走，**正因为它是噪声**，**所以没有任何东西按它定价**」**——**⭐ 本词条认为这是本站所见**对「不要按噪声定价」写得最直接的一句****。**⑤ ⭐⭐⭐ **测试是**结构性质测试**，且每条都指向模型所依赖的机制**——**逐字为**：**「Property tests for the machinery the model rests on: **Gumbel h-function inversion round-trips to 1e-8**, sampled margins pass **Kolmogorov–Smirnov** against U(0,1), **every vine pair recovers its target Kendall’s tau**, **Gumbel shows upper-tail dependence where the tau-matched Gaussian does not**, the 5-dim vine-implied correlation matrix **stays positive definite across the whole theta range**, and **the severity distributions reproduce the published ABI means**.」**⭐⭐⭐ **四处值得记**：**① ⭐⭐⭐ **六条断言全部是**结构性的**（**往返精度、分布拟合、τ 复现、上尾相依的有无、相关矩阵正定、均值复现已发表值**）**——**⭐ 即**它测的不是「跑得通」，而是**数学性质是否成立****；**② ⭐⭐ **「Gumbel 在上尾有相依，而 τ 匹配的高斯没有」****——**⭐ 即**它测的是 copula 家族的**定性特征**；**③ **正定性在**整个 θ 范围上**都被要求**（**不是抽样几个点**）；**④ ⭐⭐ **严重度分布必须**复现已发表的 ABI 均值**（**⭐ 又一次「标准答案来自外部」**）**。**⑥ ⭐⭐ **新灾因有各自的护栏，且其中一条**规定了某个东西不得被触碰****——**逐字为**：**「erosion’s frequency **must annualise over the horizon** and **must NOT be touched by the ABI frequency scaling**（**it has no published payout to calibrate against**）」**；**「the flood–erosion tree-2 pair **must come out as the strongest of the three**」**；**「the depth multiplier must leave the **exposure-weighted national mean at exactly 1.0** while still ranking a deep district above a shallow one」**；**「plus a **fallback test proving the model still runs when the depth product is absent, as it is outside England**」**⭐⭐⭐ **三处值得记**：**① ⭐⭐⭐ **「它没有可据以校准的已发表赔付，**因此不得被 ABI 频率缩放触碰**」**——**⭐ 即**缺一条外部参照被**明确转成一条禁止性护栏****；**② ⭐⭐ **深度乘数必须使**按暴露加权的全国均值为恰好 1.0**、同时仍能把深区排在浅区之上**——**⭐ 即**归一化与排序**两条要求同时被测**；**③ ⭐⭐⭐ **一条**兜底测试**：**证明深度数据缺失时模型仍能运行**（**逐字给出理由「as it is outside England」**）**——**⭐ 即**它测的是**数据缺口下的行为**，**而不只是数据齐备时的行为****。**⑦ ⭐⭐⭐ **「站点是被检查过的，不是被假设的」**——**这一节的写法值得整段引用**：**「## Design & accessibility** The site is **checked, not assumed**:」**，**逐字含**：**「**WCAG 2.1 AA contrast** verified **programmatically** on all four pages in **light and dark mode**（**measured from computed styles, not from the palette on paper**）. **`--ink-muted` and link colours were darkened after that audit failed 23 elements**; chart series colours 可核實資訊（**均 README 與倉庫實測**）：⭐⭐⭐ **① 兩枚徽章把「代碼許可」與「數據許可」分開寫，而數據側掛着一份 29 個數據集的來源登記表**：**本詞條**實測其 README 頂部徽章逐字為** **「Licence: MIT」**（**鏈接文本為 `code-MIT`，指向 `LICENSE`**）與 **「Data: OGL v3」**（**鏈接文本為 `data-OGL v3`，指向 `DATA_SOURCES.md`**）**，**另有 `Live site`、`tests`（指向 `.github/workflows/tests.yml`）、`Python 3.13`、`Districts: 2,736`、`Perils: 8 insured + 1` 五枚**；**並逐字說明數據側登記表的範圍**：**「Every hazard input is **open data**, fetched by the scripts here — see **`DATA_SOURCES.md`** for all **29 datasets** with their endpoints, **licences**, access quirks and **the dead ends worth avoiding**.」**⭐⭐⭐ **四處**：**① ⭐⭐⭐「代碼 MIT」與「數據 OGL v3」是**兩枚並列徽章**——**⭐ 這正好解決了本會話第 342 輪在**兩條**條目裡記錄的同一觀察（倉庫的許可與其中第三方數據的權利狀態是兩件不同的事）；而這裡不是靠免責聲明，而是把兩套許可並列掛在門口，且數據側那份文件就是它的依據****；**② ⭐⭐⭐ 它給出**數據集的精確數量**（29）並逐項列出端點、許可、取數怪癖**——**⭐ 尤其「取數怪癖」與「**值得繞開的死路**」兩欄**：**後者是本會話首次見到的**負面清單****；**③ ⭐⭐ `NOASSERTION` 的成因被本條解釋**（**兩套許可並列 → GitHub 無法歸入單一 SPDX 標識**）——**⭐ 即**這個「無法歸類」本身是聲明方式導致的，而不是未聲明****；**④ 實測根目錄含 `DATA_SOURCES.md`、`LICENSE`、`LIMITATIONS.md`、`HANDOFF.md` 四份文件**（**限制與交接各有獨立文檔**）。**② ⭐⭐⭐ **它另有一份把結論寫在頂部的範圍聲明，直接否定自己數字的用途**：**「> ⚠️ These are **eight-peril technical premiums, not home insurance premiums**. Putting it in the technical premium would **price a loss no policy pays**, and would **quietly wreck the rating**: erosion is a **total loss of the property rather than a repair**, so where it bites is likewise allocated against insured losses only.**」****⭐⭐⭐ **並給出可核對的結果**：**全國層面採納的方案把 2105 年的土地損失限制在 **250 km²**（無防護為 **435 km²**），並點名具體海濱**（Blackpool FY1、Eastbourne BN21、Bognor PO21/PO22、Crosby L22 在「Hold the Line」方案下從顯著侵蝕變為**恰好為零**），而在沒有海堤的地方，歐洲侵蝕最快的一段海岸如實顯現（**Hornsea HU18 與 Withernsea HU19 居首，其次 Southwold IP18**）。**④ ⭐⭐⭐ **它把「沒有這個功能」本身當成結論**：**其 README 有一節標題逐字為** **「## Does the copula actually matter?」**，**先給出測量方式與規模**（`scripts/dependence_check.py`，60 個區 × 40 萬年），**再給出一個分成兩半的答案**：**① 對單棟住宅**：聯合建模使「多災因年份」的概率變為 **94 倍**（0.11% 對獨立性下的 0.0012%），**但該住宅自身的 99% TVaR 幾乎不動**（**+2.7%，95% 置信區間 −9.0% 至 +12.8%**，即與零無法區分），**並逐字解釋**：**「**The interval straddling zero is the finding**; its point estimate wanders between runs **precisely because it is noise**, which is why **nothing is priced off This entry belongs to this round’s theme that **a system should be declared part by part, with each part’s applicable rules stated**; ⭐⭐⭐ **of the four it is the one that declares licensing most completely part by part**.
